scenes.title: 01 / A workspace for delivery
captions: An original full-stack project for planning, tracking and reviewing team delivery.
Explore populated fictional projects without creating a personal account.

scenes.title: 02 / Project context, sprint focus
captions: Project progress covers the whole project. Sprint metrics follow the selected sprint.

scenes.title: 03 / Connect the bigger picture
captions: Epics and features link project goals to concrete tickets across sprints.

scenes.title: 04 / Plan the selected sprint
captions: The Backlog keeps sprint work searchable, with ticket-level filters and configurable columns.

scenes.title: 05 / Requirements, estimates and child tasks
captions: Inspect the ticket requirements, ownership and planning details.
Story points, time estimates and child tasks stay connected to the same work item.

scenes.title: 06 / Tickets in rows. Tasks by state.
captions: Each row is a ticket. Columns represent the independent states of its tasks.

scenes.title: 07 / Session A · update the ticket
captions: Move the ticket from In Progress to Code Review through the actual API.

scenes.title: 08 / Session B · no refresh
captions: The same change arrives in an independent browser session over WebSockets. No refresh.

scenes.title: 09 / Session A · move a child task
captions: Task state is separate from ticket state. Move a child task into In Progress.

scenes.title: 10 / Session B · work stays in sync
captions: The moved task appears in the second session, while its parent ticket remains in Code Review.

scenes.title: 11 / People behind the work
captions: The project-wide team connects people to assigned work and sprint planning.

scenes.title: 12 / Plan available capacity
captions: Sprint capacity shows the team’s available hours and planned workload.

scenes.title: 13 / Track the sprint outcome
captions: Sprint goals pair a clear outcome with an actionable checklist and progress.

scenes.title: 14 / Make room for feedback
captions: Review what worked, what did not, and what the team can improve next.
Retrospective cards and reactions belong to the selected sprint.

scenes.title: 15 / Same workflow. Smaller screen.
captions: A real 390px viewport: responsive navigation, sprint work and contextual editing.

scenes.title: 16 / Two complete appearances
captions: Switch appearance explicitly. The choice is remembered across visits.

scenes.title: 17 / Built across the stack
captions: React + TypeScript → NestJS REST API → Prisma + PostgreSQL. Socket.IO keeps sessions synchronized.
Explore the live demo or inspect the implementation on GitHub.
